items.title: SK hynix Rides the AI Data Center Boom and HBM4 Ramp-Up
items.summary: SK hynix is well-positioned to capitalize on growing AI data center investments and rising demand for high-performance memory solutions. The company has begun mass production of HBM4 chips and expects them to surpass HBM3E in shipment volume and revenue by Q4 2026. With cloud providers expected to increase capex by 60%+ in 2027 and AI data center buildout growing at 40% CAGR through 2030, SKHY trades at a valuation discount (P/E of 3.51X vs. industry average of 9.47X) and currently holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.
